vulnerable_code:
class ProcessOrderRefundWorker
  include Sidekiq::Worker

  def perform(order_id, recipient_user_id)
    order = Order.find(order_id)
    wallet = Wallet.find_by!(user_id: recipient_user_id)

    # Refunds order amount to recipient_user_id without verifying order ownership
    wallet.credit!(order.total_amount, reason: "Refund for order ##{order.id}")
  end
end

class OrdersController < ApplicationController
  def request_refund
    ProcessOrderRefundWorker.perform_async(params[:id], current_user.id)
    render json: { message: 'Refund enqueued' }
  end
end
diagnosis: The refund worker credits the refund amount to recipient_user_id without checking that order.user_id matches recipient_user_id. An attacker can pass arbitrary victim order IDs to divert store credit refunds into their own wallet.

corrected_code:
class ProcessOrderRefundWorker
  include Sidekiq::Worker

  def perform(order_id, recipient_user_id)
    order = Order.find(order_id)
    raise 'Order ownership mismatch' unless order.user_id == recipient_user_id

    wallet = Wallet.find_by!(user_id: recipient_user_id)
    wallet.credit!(order.total_amount, reason: "Refund for order ##{order.id}")
  end
end

class OrdersController < ApplicationController
  def request_refund
    order = current_user.orders.find(params[:id])
    ProcessOrderRefundWorker.perform_async(order.id, current_user.id)
    render json: { message: 'Refund enqueued' }
  end
end
